fusions.name: Dragline Seam
fusions.desc: Draws a 6-tile seam of shifting gravel ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward, dealing 12 damage to each and stunning it for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Cobble Snare
fusions.desc: Throws a cobble that deals 5 damage and leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Hold the Line
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Weight on the Bound
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour also rises by 6%.
